description:
Outcome: The coordinator reviews applications, allocates plots and transfers unallocated applicants to the queue, from brief.md §First version must, item 2.
Scope: Ordered cohorts, preferences and prior holdings, available-plot selector, preview/confirm assignment. Persisted initial/finalized season-round state and atomic, audited, idempotent finalization serialized against application submissions.
Excludes: Automatic optimizer; reversible normal-UI finalization; map or replacement whole-garden holder dashboard.
Acceptance: Invalid/ineligible assignments refused. Finalization prohibited before Feb 1 cutoff and until eligible initial returners processed or capacity exhausted. Confirmation explains returning priority ends at finalization. Remaining applicants are queued by immutable original order; submissions during/after finalization cannot be lost or bypass the queue. Spare capacity after finalization is allocated via head-only queue promotion.
Behaviour: No-applicant/full-garden states, confirmation and actionable stale-view recovery; concurrent finalization cannot duplicate or omit queue entries.
Verification: End-to-end initial round with more than 40 applicants, permission checks, pre-cutoff finalization refusal, concurrent submit/finalize, repeated finalization and durable round-state tests.
Prerequisites: T-003, T-006, T-007.
Assumptions: One household per plot/season; coordinator intentionally finalizes after reviewing initial applications; no normal UI round reopening.
title: Build coordinator allocation and round finalization
